title: ranunculus occidentalis var. eisenii
intro: Ranunculus occidentalis var. eisenii, commonly known as Western Buttercup, is a plant species found in the western United States. It is a type of flowering plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its ability to treat various health issues, including fever and rheumatism, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus occidentalis var. eisenii include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation.
